title: Chapter 719
text:
Psychic poison sounded quite serious. Although Han Xiao felt that it was troublesome, he did not panic. He had always believed that there were more ways than difficulties.

"You can't get rid of the poison either?" Han Xiao asked Lagi.

"The most I can do is inscribe a spiritual defense rune formation on your body to slow down the corrosion of the psychic poison." Lagi sighed. "However, none of these methods can cure you. It was indeed a mistake for me to choose to become a Mage."

Fu Ding interrupted. "I can also help you strengthen your spiritual barrier and suppress the psychic poison. As for completely getting rid of it, we can't do that. You'll have to think of another way."

Fu Ding's talent was the highest in the army, and he had entered the Calamity Grade earlier than Sylvia. However, his position in the army was similar to a guest, and he did not have a specific position.

"Then help me suppress the psychic poison first. I'll think of other ways."

Han Xiaoxin relaxed. As long as he was not completely helpless, it would be easy to deal with.

The psychic energy of a Beyond Grade A was very strong, but a Calamity Grade Super could still defend against it to a certain extent.

Fu Ding's spiritual body shone brightly, and an endless stream of psychic energy surged out like a tide, wrapping around Han Xiao's mental world. Countless hexagonal structures appeared on his spiritual barrier.

Very soon, the activity of the psychic poison decreased significantly, and the purplish-black fog showed a certain degree of inertia.

Han Xiao felt refreshed, and the feeling of weakness and mental disturbance lessened significantly. The attribute reduction of [Soul Poisoning] was reduced from twenty percent to fourteen percent, and the negative effects of [Whisper Hallucination] and [Sensory Misdirection] were also significantly weakened.

"The rune formation needs to be inscribed on your body. Let's go out first." Lagi's spiritual body exited Han Xiao's mental world chat room.

Han Xiao and Fu Ding also retracted their spiritual bodies, and their senses returned to the outside world. Han Xiao's vision changed, and he returned to the training room of the spaceship. Fu Ding retracted his finger and walked to the side.

Lagi walked over, and with a flip of his hand, an emerald green crystal wand the length of an arm appeared. At the end of the wand, bright magic Radiance flickered, emitting bits of light.

With a wave of his hand, a dozen or so thick spell books appeared in front of him. The pages flipped automatically, making rustling sounds. As Lagi flipped through the book, pages filled with all kinds of magic languages would fall off from time to time and surround him. These were the records of magic circles that Lagi wanted to engrave for Han Xiao after searching through the magic books. He took them out for reference.

"Take off your shirt. I want to draw a formation on your body."

Han Xiao unbuttoned his shirt, revealing his muscular upper body. His tight abdominal muscles and firm back muscles gave off a sense of strength, as well as a sense of streamlined beauty. He was not as muscular as a Pugilist, but he was strong to the point of perfection. The ability [Golden Ratio Body] that he had drawn allowed his figure to be like a work of art.

"Go ahead." Han Xiao nodded.

Rabin channeled his magic power and his eyes glowed. Using his wand as a brush and his magic power as paint, he drew a magic circle on Han Xiao's body.

The cold magic power flowed through his body, accompanied by bursts of stinging pain and itchiness. It was quite similar to the feeling of a tattoo.

After drawing for about ten minutes, Lagi exhaled and spat out a cloud of magic aura. The light in his eyes gradually faded. For a Great Mage like him, using ten minutes to engrave a set of enchantments was already extremely serious.

Lagi took a few steps back and sized up Han Xiao. He sighed and said, "Although I don't know if it will be useful … my drawing is really beautiful."

Han Xiao lowered his head and observed. At this moment, his upper body was already covered with extremely complicated runes. They were like tattoos that could not be erased.

His left chest muscles were covered with a blue-gold circular magic circle. His abdomen was covered with many irregular magic circles that were arranged like constellations. They were connected together by chain-like runes. His arms were covered with runes as if they were chains wrapping around his arms. His back was also covered with magic circles. With his spine as the trunk, the magic circles extended out like dense bushes and fruits.

Other than his face and head, Han Xiao's upper body was covered with runes that were flickering. The frequency of the runes was like breathing.

"I used a portable enchantment technique. With your body as the foundation, I engraved runes on it. It will automatically absorb the wandering magic elements in the outside world to replenish its energy and maintain its operation."

Portable enchantment was an important technique in the Enchantment class. It was used to enchant living beings and strengthen certain qualities of the other party. Some magic civilizations would use this method to increase the combat power of their soldiers. Some experts would also enchant their own bodies and solidify certain spells. Han Xiao was no stranger to this type of enchantment. In his previous life, there were Mages who specialized in this business. Players could get the service as long as they spent money.

This was also an important business for Mages to earn money, just like how Mechanics sold their products.

Han Xiao touched his arm curiously. His fingertips could clearly feel the runes. Even with his experience, he felt that the enchantment on his body was extremely complicated.

"The limitation of a portable enchantment is the strength of the person being enchanted. The more enchantments there are, the greater the burden. Luckily, your body is very tough, so I engraved a large number of runes on you," Lagi said.

Lagi continued, "The Holy Emperor's Protection, the White Magic Ancestor's Embrace, Layerbis' Autism, and five other types of mental defense arrays. There are also the Thirteen Rings Secret Technique Alchemy Array that stabilizes the mind, the Mind Furnace that increases the mind, and so on."

"The effect is not bad. I feel much better."

With the various illusions suppressed, Han Xiao's mind became much clearer. Looking at the interface, the various negative statuses were weakened once again. The [Soul Poison]'s reduction of all attributes was reduced to five percent. The effect was already very small.

On the interface, the effects of these portable enchantments were displayed. Most of them increased the value of his Psychic Resistance. Due to the increase in the base value, the bonus effect of his [Advanced Mental Resilience] also increased.

"By the way, I also engraved a psychic detection rune array for you."

Lagi pointed at a small rune array on Han Xiao's chest. "As long as you focus your consciousness on it, you will be able to enter the mental region on your own. You don't need our help. I feel that you might need this ability to observe the corrosion of the psychic poison."

"That's practical."

Han Xiao was overjoyed. The Mechanic class was more materialistic and did not have any psychic abilities. They could not detect the mental region on their own, so he could not ask for help every time. With this enchantment, he would be able to enter his mental world at any time.

He tested it out, and his vision instantly changed. His spiritual body entered his mental region alone.

At this time, in his mental region, there were layers of barriers blocking the psychic poison. The area of the poison was suppressed and reduced from ten percent to six percent.

"These methods can only suppress it. It seems like I'll still need the help of a Beyond Grade A to get rid of the poison …" Han Xiao thought.

There was no need to mention Sisko. He did not know whether he was friend or foe. Furthermore, the two of them did not have much of a relationship, so Han Xiao did not plan to look for him. It was more convenient to ask Austin for help. Although Austin was not a professional Psychic, the Mage class and the Psychic class both belonged to the Mystic class.

Han Xiao left the mental world and took out his communicator. After thinking for a while, he put on his clothes before contacting Austin.

"Black Star?" The child-like Austin appeared in the virtual screen with a curious expression. "We haven't contacted each other for a few years. Why are you looking for me?"

"Your Excellency Magus, I hope to receive your help …"

Han Xiao nodded and explained.

"You actually got hit by Sisko's psychic attack. You're very unlucky." Austin smiled. "Alright, come and find me. I haven't seen Sisko in a long time. Let me see how much he's improved."

Of the four Beyond Grade As in the Shattered Star Ring, Heber was domineering, Ames was willful, and Sisko was cold. Only Austin was kind and nice. Upon hearing Han Xiao's request, he agreed immediately.

After hanging up, Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief. He turned to look at Lagi and asked, "Do you want to follow me to Austin's territory?"

Lagi shook his head. Since he had come out, he did not want to go back.

"Alright, then you'll be in charge of the Black Star Corps and cooperate with Herlous and Sylvia to deal with the aftermath of this battle. I'll be leaving for a while." "Right now, only the two of you know about my current situation in the army," Han Xiao said seriously. "Don't tell anyone else."

Even Joad did not know the exact effects of the psychic poison on him. Han Xiao planned to keep the news a secret, not wanting to expose his temporary weakness.

"Fu Ding, follow me for now," Han Xiao said.

With Fu Ding by his side, he could use the Advanced Luck Glow. Furthermore, if the psychic poison mutated, Fu Ding would be able to help him to a certain extent. Most importantly, fighting personally would cause his energy to become nutrients for the psychic poison. Thus, he had to bring some fighters with him. Fu Ding was now a Grade A Psychic, so his combat strength was reliable.

"You're in trouble now, so of course I'll be by your side."

Fu Ding smiled warmly, and his handsome face seemed to be emitting Radiance.

Please retract your God Power and stop using Charm … Han Xiao felt a headache coming on.

…

After the counterattack battle ended, Section Zero left some troops to guard the Kant Star System border and set up a blockade to prevent Bloodshed Land from making a comeback. The other participating organizations also returned with a bountiful harvest.

The one million or so players who participated in the battle were satisfied and returned with the team. Han Xiao took Feidin and another fighter, Marian, and left the main group, heading toward the Hidden Red Robe Abbey in Austin.

The faction interface allowed him to issue faction missions remotely, and all the necessary items were placed in the faction store. Han Xiao did not need to be by the players' side all the time.

The players had earned a lot this time, and with the fifty percent discount not over yet, there would always be people spending money in the army. Thus, Han Xiao did not need to worry for the time being. Furthermore, after this battle, there would not be any large-scale military operations for a while, so he had enough free time to deal with the problem of the psychic poison.

The Hidden Red Robe Abbey was located in another Star Cluster, and it was quite far away. Han Xiao and the other two set off on their journey.

At the same time, on Planet Heber, the Bloodshed Land headquarters had been dealt with.

The command center was calculating the losses of this defeat. Jorde listened to his subordinate's report. The losses were not small, but he was all smiles and was not angry at all.

Section Zero had sent out all their forces, so it was normal for them to be expelled. However, the biggest result this time was that they had successfully ambushed Black Star, and Joad was very satisfied with this result.

Black Star was just one person, but he possessed overwhelming strength at the high-level combatants level. In the past ten years, Bloodshed Land had lost hundreds of Calamity Grade Supers to Black Star. Even with an entire Star Cluster as a reserve, this was not a small number.

Heber's heart was as hard as steel, and he did not care about the losses. However, Joad could not. He was a meticulous butler, and he was more worried about the loss of high-level combatants than anyone else. If not for the fact that Heber wanted to rear pigs, Joad would not have dared to let Han Xiao continue to be active in the war.

He had used so many methods and still failed to kill Black Star. Even if Black Star had been ambushed, Joad did not feel that he could threaten his life. Thus, he did not plan to carry out any follow-up assassinations. He would leave Black Star for His Excellency Tyrant to deal with.

Joad was in a good mood. He was already very satisfied with being able to weaken Black Star.

Although he did not know what kind of injuries Black Star had suffered, Joad secretly prayed for the best outcome. He hoped that Black Star would not be able to continue participating in the battle and that Purple Crystal would not be able to use this trump card.

Without Black Star, the high-level combatants of Bloodshed Land would have the qualifications to be arrogant.

…

In a certain Star System in the Colton Star Cluster, Floating Dragon Island was slowly drifting in the universe.

Compared to seven years ago, the terrain of Floating Dragon Island had changed significantly. There were now three floating islands, one big and two small.

The biggest island was the original floating island, and it was now the main island. The other two small floating islands were like satellites surrounding the main island. These were the two new sub islands, where Floating Dragon's armed forces were stationed.

With the support of the Black Star Corps, Vilna had used seven years to expand Floating Dragon's second Field Team to a rather large scale. Even the port of the main island could not fit them. The two sub islands were military camps. They were the land that Aesop had asked Ames to dig out from the surface of the planet using her force field.

After seven years of development, Floating Dragon also had a new look.

At this moment, Ames, Aesop, Vilna, and Jenny were all gathered at the port of Floating Dragon's main island. All the famous members of Floating Dragon were there.

A brand new small dark red spaceship was docked at the port. Hella and Aurora carried their luggage and stood in front of everyone.

The two of them still had the same temperament, but they were much more mature than seven years ago. The two of them were wearing different styles of battle suits. Hella's suit was black and red, and Aurora's was white with gold edges.

"Are you really not going to consider staying and helping me?" Vilna asked with a regretful expression.

Now that the Black Star Corps was close to independence, the second armed force led by Vilna was Floating Dragon's exclusive fleet. She was the fleet commander, and there were many elites under her command.

She had worked for Floating Dragon for seven years and had built a deep relationship with the officers of Floating Dragon. She was also quite close with Hella and Aurora.

Today was the day that Hella and Aurora would leave Floating Dragon. After training with the Dragon Emperor for more than ten years, Hella finally decided to leave.

Vilna had asked the two sisters to stay and become her right-hand men more than once, but the two of them had already made up their minds.

"Sorry, Sister Vilna. We have made an agreement with Uncle Black Star a long time ago. We will definitely go and find him." Aurora had an apologetic expression.

Vilna sighed. The Black Star Corps had helped her a lot, and Hella and Black Star had a deep bond. She did not want to keep poaching them.

Jenny snorted and said, "I have already transferred 200,000 Enas into your account, which should be enough for your journey. Black Star is the one with the most money. When you join him, you won't need me to give you money anymore."

"Thank you, Sister Jenny." Aurora thanked her politely.

"Humph." Jenny turned her head away. The two of them insisted on joining the Black Star Corps, which made her very depressed.

Wilsander chuckled. "When you see Black Star, remember to say hello for me."

"Okay." Aurora nodded.

"By the way, say hello for me too." Floating Dragon's logistics manager, Haier, who was used to being transparent, also spoke.

"Got it."

Aurora shrunk her neck. After more than ten years together, Haier's hideous appearance still made her a little scared.

Aesop shook his head and said, "I have peeped into your future. I don't know if it is the right thing to ask you to find Black Star."

"Fate is always in an uncertain state and can change at any time. This is what you told us." Aurora blinked her big eyes and said crisply.

Aesop sighed again and again, mumbling words like 'Black Star', 'death', 'war', and so on.

In the end, Hella and Hella's eyes gathered on Ames.

Ames smiled faintly. Her red lips moved slightly, and her voice was very soft.

"Be careful on the way."

Aurora smiled sweetly. "I know, Teacher."

Hella, who had been expressionless and silent all this time, had a look of respect in her eyes. She nodded and bowed.

"Thank you very much for teaching me for more than ten years."

A kind look flashed across Ames' eyes. She nodded and did not say anything else.

Hella straightened up and glanced at her friends of more than ten years. She pulled Aurora, who looked back every three steps, turned around, and stepped onto the gangway of the small dark red spaceship. They walked into the cabin and closed the cabin door.

Under the gaze of Ames and the others, the spaceship slowly rose into the sky, turned into a ray of light, and disappeared on the other side of the planet.

Ames looked in the direction of the spaceship with her hands behind her back and softly muttered to herself, "So this is what it feels like to be a teacher …"
